fields.Name: T204 - Discard Unsaved Edit
fields.Description: Edits a field on an Event record then discards/cancels the change without saving, verifying unsaved changes can be abandoned cleanly.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Change the 'Location' text field to 'Temporary Edit 204'. An unsaved-changes banner appears at the TOP with a 'Save Changes' button and usually a 'Revert'/'Cancel'/'Discard' option. Do NOT save — instead discard the change (click Revert/Cancel/Discard, or navigate away and decline saving). Verify you end up with the change abandoned and no error (the field shows its original value, or you are back on a clean view). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away unexpectedly.

judgeValidationCriteria: A field was edited then the change was discarded/reverted without saving
The app handled the discard cleanly (original value retained or clean navigation), no error
No crash pages or stuck states
